title: Litheson - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Litheson in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Litheson is a physical-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Agility (B), Vitality (A).

sections.title: Is the Litheson Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (B), Vitality (A). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
